crack-strip.subject: a straight horizontal strip of branching fractured ground seams, narrow central split and irregular fine side cracks; painted strictly top-down, no rocks protruding upward

stone-spike.subject: an upright compact eruption of solid jagged stone spikes, one main irregular crystalline stone point and a few smaller rooted shards; solid rock facets, root at lower center, no ground disk

wave-crest.subject: one upright curling wave crest with layered foam and a strong readable curved leading edge, traveling toward canvas right; front-facing game sprite, no water plane or horizon

arrow-core.subject: one solid arrow flying toward canvas right, sharp metal arrowhead at right, straight short shaft and small feather fletching at left, crisp silhouette, no magical tail

orb-core.subject: one round translucent magical sphere, true circular silhouette, layered swirling interior and sharp internal highlights, no flame-shaped tail or ring around it

rock-core.subject: one compact irregular rocky meteor body, solid chipped facets and deep fissures, readable chunky silhouette; no fire, tail, dust cloud or ground plane

forked-bolt.subject: one tall narrow descending lightning strike with a jagged vertical white-hot main trunk and a few short branching forks, bottom contact point at lower center; no impact burst or ground ring

ground-spiral.subject: one true circular magical spiral on a ground surface seen strictly straight down, several interleaved curved energy arms and a readable dark central eye, no upright funnel, no perspective ellipse
